snippet.title: (WIP) Galaxy Angel Speedrun segmented  - Chapter 1 (9:06)
snippet.description:
this game is a Visual Novel and a Real Time Strategy game made by Broccoli.
It's the PC version, more easier to speedrun than the PS2 version, thanks to the mouse and keyboard.
It's not an official speedrun but I wanted to do a first run to approximate how fast can I go on this game.
mouse auto-fire is used on text scenes
the game was translated using a patch.

Chapter 1:

part 1: 40:03
part 2: 4:04:05
part 3: 58:20
part 4: 3:24:15

total:

9:06:43

My strategy on this run will be to maximise ranpha's affection to boost her in fight and defeat the enemy really fast.
ranpha has the fastest emblem frame, and she can kill nearly any boss in one hit with her special attack Anchor Claw, even if she lacks force compared to the other angels.
so I'll just have to rush on bosses with ranpha and launch a special attack on them.
